availability_zone.description: Compute AZ within the region (nova:default, nova:az1, ...).

key_name.description: SSH keypair name in Nova (optional — bootstrap access).

labels.description:
VM labels, stored in Nova server.metadata. The `soulstack-run` key
is used by the driver for idempotency.

network_id.description: Neutron network ID that the VM's primary interface attaches to.

region.description:
OpenStack region name (RegionName in the Keystone catalog). Optional:
private clouds without regions leave the field empty.

security_groups.description: Names of Neutron security groups attached to the VM.
